title: Improvisation workshop by NDT dancers Luca Tessarini and Nicole Ishimaru - ABN AMRO x NDT

method.teacher_system: The teachers introduce improvisation tasks focusing on body qualities like tense-release, space exploration, and breathing. They demonstrate small movements and guide learners to expand them organically without falling into habits.
method.signature: Guided internal exploration tasks like tense-release walking and imagining imaginary rooms.

practices.what: Explore tense and release connected to small steps in any direction.
Incorporate shoulders, hands, elbows, neck, and lower back into the movement.
Play with levels including knees, thighs, and lower back.
Create an imaginary room with walls, stairs, and doors while walking.
Imagine small balloons inside that inflate and pop while moving.
Imagine cleaning a table with mess above and below while keeping the rest of the body free.

adaptations.adjustment: Take a couple of tiny little steps in any direction
Start very small, because smaller is better for progress
Walk in a tiny space and focus purely on the act of walking

beliefs.belief: Improvisation is a form of escape, freedom of expression, and a way of reconnecting to ourselves.
The smaller you start, the better, so you have more progress and decisions are made by your body.
We are pedestrians, not influenced by anything except our own little planet.

moments.says: The teacher welcomes the viewer to a guided improvisation workshop and invites anyone watching from home to take part.
The teacher introduces a tense-and-release task connected to simple steps, suggesting starting very small for more progress.
The teacher reminds the viewer not to forget to breathe and to play with holding and releasing breath.
The teacher invites a small break to take a moment to breathe after moving.

mentor.what_stays: The teacher leaves the learner feeling free to explore movement naturally and connect with their own body at their own pace.

struggles.theme: Movements look tense and unnatural like a patient waking from a coma
Movements feel too trivial and not fully connected

clicked.theme: Felt connected to tiny space during lockdown
Brought moment of meditation and breathing
Able to do exercises right from bed or mattress

requests.theme: Ask for more improvisation videos and lessons
Ask for other lead improv sources

meant.theme: Missed dancing at home and felt a sense of professional company class
Provided a wonderful meditational and enlightening experience
Enjoyed watching from various countries around the world

method.limits: The video is performed in a black box studio with dark clothing, making some spatial boundaries and fine details harder to distinguish on video.
